Draft: island 2.2, landmark (b), round 2, design 2: the ribbon of lines

A BATCH of four masked lines rides one belt into TransBERT-bio-fr and leaves it on the same belt, each guess graded: green with a tick when right, red with a cross when wrong. Under the outgoing belt, like a conveyor's return run, the reds' branches gather into ONE red pipe that runs back into the model, pulses riding it; where it lands, the model's network lights red from the output back toward the input: the wrong guesses correct the model. TransCorpus-bio-fr feeds it from above. Round 1's transbert_model, masked_line, predicted_token are called, read-only.

the idea, composed

Whole size (756 × 556), then 1/3 and 1/20.

graded_token-right

A graded token: the model's guess for a hidden token, marked RIGHT (a green capsule with a white tick) or WRONG (a red capsule with a white cross). CONTAINS ['predicted_token']. A right guess, an 8-letter place.

graded_token-wrong

A graded token: the model's guess for a hidden token, marked RIGHT (a green capsule with a white tick) or WRONG (a red capsule with a white cross). CONTAINS ['predicted_token']. A wrong guess, the same place.

graded_line-right

A graded line: a tokenized line whose hidden token has been guessed by the model and marked right (green, ticked) or wrong (red, crossed). CONTAINS ['token_bead', 'graded_token']. "infarctus du myocarde", the guess right.

graded_line-wrong

A graded line: a tokenized line whose hidden token has been guessed by the model and marked right (green, ticked) or wrong (red, crossed). CONTAINS ['token_bead', 'graded_token']. The same line, the guess wrong.

batch_of_lines-masked

A batch of lines: several different tokenized lines, each with a different piece hidden, riding side by side on one conveyor belt -- the lines the model is shown at once, or the same lines with its guesses graded. CONTAINS ['masked_line', 'graded_line']. Four lines going in, each a different piece hidden.

batch_of_lines-graded

A batch of lines: several different tokenized lines, each with a different piece hidden, riding side by side on one conveyor belt -- the lines the model is shown at once, or the same lines with its guesses graded. CONTAINS ['masked_line', 'graded_line']. The same four coming out, graded: two right, two wrong.

correction_signal

A correction signal: the error of the wrong guesses, gathered from each red line into one red pipe that runs back under the batch and into the model, white-hot pulses riding it toward the model -- back-propagation, without a word. CONTAINS []. Shown under the graded batch it gathers from: the two reds' branches meet in one pipe that runs back left.

learning_model

TransBERT-bio-fr learning: the model board with the part of its network the correction reaches lit up in the correction's colour, brightest at the output and fading back toward the input -- the weights being adjusted, backwards. CONTAINS ['transbert_model']. 250 tall, adjusting.

transbert_model and learning_model

Round 1's model, and the same model as the correction lands. Proofs, checked each time the sheet is written: graded_token without a verdict is predicted_token byte for byte; learning_model not adjusting is transbert_model byte for byte.
